category_title: Latino students whose disruptive or defiant behavior is interpreted as 'uncharacteristic'
minimal_context: The class is transitioning to Mr. Beattie's classroom and the students are asked to line up quietly.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time to transition to Mr. Beattie's classroom. Everyone needs to line up and be quiet.

STUDENT: (Refuses to line up)

TUTOR: I still hear people talking!

STUDENT: We're going on strike!

TUTOR: Please get in line so we can leave.

STUDENT: (Singing) Oakdale school, is not the best school for you. I hate Oakdale, I hate Oakdale.

options.A: Give the student a warning, followed by a 10-minute timeout if they do not desist.
options.B: Ask the class to put their hands up, slap their desks twice, and say 'Mr. Beattie!'
options.C: Have a peer offer the student transition choices using picture cards with movement actions.
options.D: Alter the original transition plans for the class and incorporate the student's singing contributions.
